authored_by: the synthesis lane, on the owner's authorization of 2026-08-22 ("build it out like a ledger using your own knowledge")
rule: This ledger rules on the bridge's corpus_family VALUES, never on individual works: each of the bridge's recorded values is folded into exactly one canonical family below, with the evidence for the ruling beside it. A work stays wherever its bridge value puts it — re-placing single works one by one is the fudge this project bans, and per-work anomalies are findings for the corpus lane, listed in notes. Every Hebrew name below was verified against the route store: each token's exact-K key is recorded where the store answers for it, and a token the store is silent on carries no key and opens nothing. A value the bridge adds tomorrow that this ledger does not map must surface on the door verbatim, never be swallowed.
dies_when: the corpus lane rules the family column clean — a corpus-side family record retires this ledger the day it lands, value for value

families.what: The Hebrew Bible: Torah, Nevi'im, Ketuvim — and, as the bridge currently files them, the commentaries and Torah targums riding under its value.
families.ruling: The bridge's own value, kept. Note for the corpus lane: 43 of its 82 works are commentaries (Chizkuni, Mizrachi, Siftei Chakhamim…) and five Onkelos volumes plus Targum Neofiti — targums filed here while the other targums stand at targum.

families.what: The Aramaic renderings of the books of the Tanakh.
families.ruling: The bridge's own value, kept, as the owner ruled on 2026-08-22: the Hebrew books stand at tanakh, their Aramaic renderings here.

families.what: The six orders of the Mishnah, tractate by tractate.
families.ruling: The bridge's own value, kept — 68 works, all mishnah/ tractates.

families.what: The Tosefta's tractates, the Mishnah's companion corpus.
families.ruling: The bridge's own value, kept — 94 works, all tosefta/ ids.

families.what: The Talmud and its commentaries — at present the bridge carries the Jerusalem Talmud's tractates and commentaries on them.
families.ruling: The bridge's own value, kept. Its 42 works are Yerushalmi tractates plus the Gra's and others' commentaries on them; no Bavli stands in the bridge yet, and this ledger does not invent one.

families.what: Midrash aggadah and midrash halakhah, with their commentaries.
families.ruling: mekhilta's one work is midrash/mekhilta-derabbi-shimon-ben-yochai — midrash halakhah under its own id prefix; a one-work value folds into the shelf its own id names.

families.what: The codes and their expansions: Shulchan Arukh, Arukh HaShulchan, the halakhic literature around them.
families.ruling: halakhah and halakhah_expansion are one shelf split by a working suffix (30 halakhah/ ids beside 77 halakhah-expansion/ ids). kabbalah_hebrew_thought holds exactly one work, halakhah/ben-ish-chai — its own id prefix names the shelf, whatever the value says.

families.what: Questions asked and answered, from the Geonim to the moderns.
families.ruling: geonim's four works are Teshuvot HaGeonim collections (Coronel, Harkavy, Shaarei Teshuvah, Toratan shel Rishonim) — geonic responsa by their own titles. responsa_geonim_bounded holds the Epistle of Rav Sherira Gaon, itself a teshuvah to Kairouan and already marked responsa by its value. sherira_hai_gaon_stream holds one geonim/ work of Rav Hai Gaon, folded with its era's responsa.

families.what: Siddurim, machzorim, piyyutim, and the prayers around them.
families.ruling: Both values hold only liturgy/ ids — one shelf split by a working suffix.

families.what: The mystical literature: Zohar and its commentaries, the Ari's writings, Hekhalot, and the kabbalists after them.
families.ruling: Seven working values over one shelf: the Zohar commentaries, Etz Chaim (the kabbalah value already holds eleven other ari/ works), Tikkunei Zohar, Abulafia, the Rashash's tefillah, and Hekhalot Rabbati (the merkavah literature is shelved with kabbalah). daat_tevunot's one work is kabbalah/daat-tevunot — the Ramchal under his own id prefix.

families.what: The chasidic masters, the Baal Shem Tov's school onward.
families.ruling: tanya's one work is chasidut/tanya — the foundational Chabad work under its own id prefix.

families.what: The literature of self-examination, medieval and modern.
families.ruling: Two spellings of one word over one shelf; every work in both carries a musar/ id.

families.what: Machshavah from the rishonim to Rav Kook: philosophy, theology, and the essays between them.
families.ruling: rav-kook, orot_work (Orot HaKodesh) and shemona_kevatzim (Shemonah Kevatzim) are five works of one author whose corpus is machshavah; author facets are not families.

families.what: The grammarians and the Masorah: dictionaries, grammars, and the accents.
families.ruling: Three working values over one shelf: Sefat Yeter and Dikdukei HaTeamim (masorah/), Machberet Menachem and Sefer HaRikmah and Sefer HaBachur (grammar/), and Radak's Sefer HaShorashim (a dictionary, wherever its reference/ prefix points). The second token of the Hebrew name carries no key — the store does not answer for the conjoined form, so it prints and opens nothing.

families.what: Philo, Josephus, Maccabees, Ben Sira, Jubilees — the literature of the Second Temple era.
families.ruling: Both values hold only second-temple/ ids — one shelf split by a review suffix.

families.what: The Kuzari in Ibn Tibbon's Hebrew, the poetry of Shmuel HaNagid, Ibn Ezra, Yehuda Halevi — medieval Hebrew letters.
families.ruling: The bridge's own value, kept — 700 Ben-Yehuda Project works. No Hebrew name is given yet: the candidates this lane would reach for are not attested in the store, and a name the store cannot open is not offered.

families.what: The Ben-Yehuda Project's modern corpus: Ahad Ha'am, Frishman, Berdichevsky — essays, journalism, and fiction.
families.ruling: Two values over one modern corpus: hebrew_literature is 520 pby/ works and hebrew_thought is 1,799 works of which 1,713 are pby/. Note for the corpus lane: hebrew_thought also carries 66 classic machshavah works (Maharal, Akeidat Yitzchak, Derekh Hashem, twelve rav-kook/ ids) that belong with jewish-thought when the column is re-ruled — this ledger rules values, not works, so they stand here until then, named.

families.what: Bibliography and reference: the Chida's Shem HaGedolim.
families.ruling: The value holds exactly one work, reference/shem-hagedolim-maarekhet-sefarim — a bibliographic lexicon; the author-stream value mislabels it and its own id prefix names the shelf.

awaiting.why: These two values are the corpus lane's own review markers, not classifications: unclassified_review holds 80 works across mishnah/, tosefta/ and tanakh/ prefixes (mostly the Boaz commentary on Mishnah tractates), and facet_author_needs_attachment_review holds fourteen gra/ works spanning halakhah, kabbalah and Tanakh commentary. Ruling them here would overrule a review the corpus lane has explicitly left open; they stand together, named, until it closes.
